questions.question: Which dance style was recognised by the famous 'Tanjore Quartet' of the nineteenth century?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharatanatyam** is one of the oldest classical dance forms of **India** and is believed to have originated in **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• The **Tanjore Quartet**, comprising four brothers—**Chinnayya, Ponnayya, Sivanandam, and Vadivelu**—were instrumental in codifying and organizing Bharatanatyam in the 19th century.
 
• They were musicians, composers, and dance teachers who worked under the patronage of the **Maratha rulers** of Thanjavur (Tanjore).
 
• The Tanjore Quartet systematized the structure of Bharatanatyam performances into the traditional **Margam**, which includes sections like **Alarippu, Jathiswaram, Varnam, Padam, and Thillana.**
 
• Bharatanatyam is deeply rooted in religious and spiritual themes and is often dedicated to **Hindu deities**, especially **Lord Shiva** (Nataraja).
 
• This dance form is known for its intricate footwork, graceful expressions, and strong emphasis on **abhinaya** (expressive acting).
 
• The name Bharatanatyam is derived from the combination of **‘Bhava’ (expression), ‘Raga’ (melody), ‘Tala’ (rhythm), and ‘Natyam’ (dramatic art).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kathakali**__

 __
 
• **Kathakali** is a classical dance form from **Kerala**, known for its elaborate costumes, makeup, and storytelling.
 
• It is performed as a combination of **dance, drama, and music**, often depicting stories from the **Ramayana and Mahabharata.**
 
• Kathakali performers use intricate hand gestures and facial expressions to convey emotions.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**__
 __
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form originating from **North India**, primarily associated with **storytelling through dance.**
 
• It incorporates intricate footwork, spins, and rhythmic patterns, often accompanied by **Hindustani classical music.**
 
• Kathak evolved in **royal courts** and later incorporated elements of **Mughal culture.**
 
 
 
• **Mohiniattam**__
 
 
• **Mohiniattam** is a classical dance form from **Kerala**, characterized by graceful, feminine movements.
 
• The word **‘Mohini’** refers to the enchanting female form, often associated with the mythology of **Lord Vishnu** as Mohini.
 
• Mohiniattam is performed in **solo** and is set to **Carnatic music.**

• The literacy rate of 18.33% highlighted the challenges in education and marked the beginning of efforts to improve literacy under the **Five-Year Plans** and other government initiatives.
 
• The 1951 census also emphasized the need for policies to enhance education access, particularly in rural and underprivileged areas.

• The literacy rate serves as a fundamental indicator of a country's development and is closely tied to **economic growth, social progress, and empowerment**.

questions.question: Two containers contains 765 litres and 833 litres of liquid, respectively. The maximum capacity of container that can measure the liquid of both containers is:

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the maximum capacity, we need the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of 765 and 833.

Using the difference method: Difference = 833 − 765 = 68.

The HCF must be a factor of 68. Since both 765 and 833 are odd, their HCF must be odd.

The factors of 68 are 1, 2, 4, 17, 34, 68. The highest odd factor is 17.

Checking divisibility: 765 ÷ 17 = 45 and 833 ÷ 17 = 49 (both are perfectly divisible).

**∴ The correct answer is 17 litres.**

Quantity of liquid in first container = 765 litres

Maximum measuring capacity = HCF of given quantities

 
 765 Litres

 833 Litres
 49 segments of 17L

 
 Maximum measuring capacity = 17L (HCF)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Finding HCF by prime factorization method:

⇒ Prime factors of 765 = 3 × 3 × 5 × 17 = 3² × 5 × 17

⇒ Prime factors of 833 = 7 × 7 × 17 = 7² × 17

⇒ The common prime factor between the two quantities is 17.

⇒ ∴ HCF (765, 833) = 17

⇒ The maximum capacity of the container that can measure both quantities is 17 litres.

**∴ The correct answer is 17 litres.**

Highest Common Factor (HCF)

HCF is the largest positive integer that divides two or more numbers without leaving any remainder. It is also called the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD).

The HCF of two numbers is either their difference or a factor of their difference. This is a very useful shortcut to find HCF quickly in exams by avoiding prime factorization of large numbers.

Relation between HCF and LCM

For any two numbers 'a' and 'b', the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: a × b = HCF × LCM.

questions.question: The LCM of 36, 63, 372 and 126 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The LCM of the given numbers must be a multiple of all of them.

Since 36 is one of the numbers, the LCM must be perfectly divisible by both 4 and 9.

Divisibility by 4 (last two digits): Options 7813 and 7897 are eliminated.

Divisibility by 9 (sum of digits): For 7860 → 21 (Not divisible). For 7812 → 18 (Divisible).

Thus, only 7812 perfectly satisfies the divisibility rules for 36.

**∴ The correct answer is 7812.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 36, 63, 372 and 126.

**Formula Used:**

The LCM is the product of the highest powers of all prime factors involved.

**Calculations:**

Finding the prime factorization of each number:

⇒ 36 = 2² × 3²

⇒ 63 = 3² × 7¹

⇒ 372 = 2² × 3¹ × 31¹

⇒ 126 = 2¹ × 3² × 7¹

Selecting the highest power of each prime factor (2, 3, 7, and 31):

⇒ LCM = 2² × 3² × 7¹ × 31¹

⇒ LCM = 4 × 9 × 7 × 31

⇒ LCM = 36 × 7 × 31

⇒ LCM = 252 × 31

⇒ LCM = 7812

**∴ The correct answer is 7812.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM and HCF Relation

For any two numbers 'a' and 'b', the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b). This rule does not strictly apply to three or more numbers directly.

Divisibility Rule of 4
